changeSet.author: homebase_db
changeSet.sql: UPDATE homebase_db.products p SET sku = 'DHN-' || UPPER(COALESCE(SUBSTRING(p.fabric, 1, 3), 'GEN')) || '-' || LPAD(CAST(sub.rn AS TEXT), 4, '0') FROM (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_time) AS rn FROM homebase_db.products WHERE sku IS NULL) sub WHERE p.id = sub.id AND p.sku IS NULL;
